svg.text: Two end plates 160 x 160 x 10, tube centred, fillet welded all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Under the bottom plate: a 70 mm spigot, 12 mm tall, welded on the centre;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it locates in the base plate's ring.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On the top plate: a ring 92 / 72, 15 tall, like the base plate's.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The tube wall sits right over the ring and under the cylinder

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: base, so the plates carry the load straight down.

svg.text: Check: the end plates are parallel to 0.5 mm; it stands without rocking.
